title: Finite actual-Q3 local measured-Renyi history stress
question: On the registered finite Q3 split-step model, do local coordinate-marginal alpha=2 likelihoods remain finite and below a preregistered diagnostic threshold across partial histories, adjoints, source orientations, beta values, spatial volumes and a small cutoff stress?

model.hamiltonian: registered Q3 onsite quartic plus nearest-neighbour bond
model.source: local configuration character exp(i amplitude sum(q_site))
model.reference: finite Gibbs density matrix of the unsplit Hamiltonian
model.history: prefixes 0, first term, and full product of each forward/reverse split order and sign
model.measurement: spectral coordinate measurement of each local q operator

finite_fixture.graph: target edge, square face, and 2x3 rectangular grid

lean_crosscheck.scope: exact finite fixture counts and finite-only firewall

next_action: If the sampled local likelihood grows or exceeds the diagnostic threshold, keep the parent common-alpha gate open and derive a cutoff-independent Gibbs-tail/common-core estimate; if it remains bounded, still require an analytic volume/source/cutoff-uniform proof before QFT promotion.
boundary: Finite matrix diagnostic only. It does not prove a Q3 common alpha, a common unbounded core, an all-shape split limit, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, a mass gap, continuum removal, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or a TECT production map.
no_overclaim: A finite local measured-Renyi table is evidence about the declared truncations and histories. It is not a thermodynamic or continuum theorem and cannot replace the missing analytic local likelihood estimate.
